sentences.text: What does a determinant actually do? {shows}Watch the unit square{applies} as a matrix acts on the plane.
sentences.spoken: What does a determinant actually do? Watch the unit square as a matrix acts on the plane.

sentences.text: The new area is {five}five times{fivex} the old one.
sentences.spoken: The new area is five times the old one.

sentences.text: For a two by two matrix, the determinant is {formula}ad minus bc.
sentences.spoken: For a two by two matrix, the determinant is ad minus bc.

sentences.text: Here: three times two, minus one times one. {lands}Five.
sentences.spoken: Here: three times two, minus one times one. Five.

sentences.text: Swap the two columns and the determinant becomes one minus six, which is {minus}minus five.
sentences.spoken: Swap the two columns and the determinant becomes one minus six, which is minus five.

sentences.text: A negative determinant means space has {flipped}flipped its orientation.
sentences.spoken: A negative determinant means space has flipped its orientation.

sentences.text: When the determinant is zero, the whole plane collapses onto a single line, and the matrix {cannot}cannot be undone.
sentences.spoken: When the determinant is zero, the whole plane collapses onto a single line, and the matrix cannot be undone.

sentences.text: A three by three determinant breaks into little two by twos. {expand}Expand along the first row.
sentences.spoken: A three by three determinant breaks into little two by twos. Expand along the first row.

sentences.text: Two times five, minus one times two, plus zero. {eight}Eight.
sentences.spoken: Two times five, minus one times two, plus zero. Eight.

sentences.text: A determinant is the area scale factor. {recap_end}Five means five times the area.
sentences.spoken: A determinant is the area scale factor. Five means five times the area.
